Duplicate Detector

MinHash/LSH based near-duplicate detection for code chunks.

Duplicate / near-duplicate code detection using MinHash + LSH.

Lightweight implementation with no external dependencies beyond Python stdlib. For large codebases (>100K chunks) consider datasketch for speed.

gigacode.duplicate_detector.find_duplicates(chunks: list[Any], threshold: float = 0.85, ngram: int = 4, num_hashes: int = 128, bands: int = 16) → list[dict[str, Any]][source]

Find near-duplicate code chunks within a buffer.

Parameters:

  • chunks – List of CodeChunk objects (or any object with .text, .file, .start_line, .end_line).

  • threshold – Jaccard similarity threshold (0.0–1.0).

  • ngram – Shingle size.

  • num_hashes – Number of MinHash hashes.

  • bands – Number of LSH bands.

Returns:

List of duplicate pair dicts with file/line metadata and similarity score.
